assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope.
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I25.10, and I49.5.
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control.
The authorization/precertification was missing (not obtained prior to the service date), rather than the service being medically unnecessary.
Reconsideration of the balance is being requested (appeal rights exist).
